---
title: "Figure 8 – Lymphoid cell composition and marker analysis across timepoints"
author: "Xin Wang"
date: "2026-08-14"
output: html_document
description: >
  (A) UMAP of lymphoid cells annotated as T-RCM, CD8+ T cells, Th1, Treg, Th17,
      gamma-delta T-17 cells, ILC-like cells, iNK cells, cNK cells, and B cells.
  (B) Dot plot of canonical marker genes for each lymphoid subset.
  (C) UMAP of lymphoid cells split by timepoint (0, 3, 7, 28 dpi), no labels.

Input:

Output: Results/Figures/Figure8/

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

## Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)
library(cowplot)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(scales)
```

## Directories

```{r directories}
SCIndir <- "/Users/XXW004/Documents/Projects/RuizRosado/PIPseq/Results/Evaluation_V022723/CellEvaluation_Subclustering_V0803/LymphoidCells/Biomarkers/UpdatedBiomarkers_V2/"
Outdir  <- "/Users/XXW004/Documents/Projects/RuizRosado/SpatialTranscriptomic/Results/Figures/Figure8/"
dir.create(Outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

## Load data

```{r load-data}
Lymphoidcells <- readRDS(paste0(SCIndir, "LymphoidcellsUpdated_WithAnn_Nocls6.rds"))
DefaultAssay(Lymphoidcells) <- "RNA"

timepoint_order <- c("0DPI", "3DPI", "7DPI", "28DPI")
Lymphoidcells$orig.ident <- factor(Lymphoidcells$orig.ident, levels = timepoint_order)

# Subset annotation order (internal labels, as produced by the subclustering script)
subset_order_raw <- c(
  "T-RCM", "Cd8", "Th1", "Treg", "Th17",
  "gamma-delta T-17 cells", "ILC-like cells", "iNK cells", "cNK cells", "B cells"
)

# Display labels for plotting
subset_display <- c(
  "T-RCM"                  = "T-RCM",
  "Cd8"                    = "CD8+ T cells",
  "Th1"                    = "Th1",
  "Treg"                   = "Treg",
  "Th17"                   = "Th17",
  "gamma-delta T-17 cells" = "gd T-17 cells",
  "ILC-like cells"         = "ILC-like cells",
  "iNK cells"               = "iNK cells",
  "cNK cells"               = "cNK cells",
  "B cells"                 = "B cells"
)
subset_order <- unname(subset_display[subset_order_raw])

Lymphoidcells$LymphoidSubset <- factor(
  unname(subset_display[as.character(Lymphoidcells$FinalLymphoidCellAnnot)]),
  levels = subset_order
)
Idents(Lymphoidcells) <- Lymphoidcells$LymphoidSubset

subset_colors <- setNames(scales::hue_pal()(length(subset_order)), subset_order)

cat("Subset counts:\n")
print(table(Lymphoidcells$LymphoidSubset))
cat("Timepoints:\n")
print(table(Lymphoidcells$orig.ident))
```

---

## Figure 8A: UMAP of lymphoid subsets

```{r fig8a-umap-clusters, fig.width=6, fig.height=4.5}
Fig8A_UMAP <- DimPlot(
  Lymphoidcells,
  group.by = "LymphoidSubset",
  label    = TRUE,
  repel    = TRUE,
  pt.size  = 0.5
) +
  scale_color_manual(values = subset_colors) +
  labs(title = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure8A_Lymphoid_UMAP_Subsets.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig8A_UMAP,
  width    = 4.5, height = 4
)
Fig8A_UMAP
```

---

## Figure 8B: Dot plot of canonical marker genes for each lymphoid subset

```{r fig8b-dotplot-markers, fig.width=12, fig.height=4.5}
Idents(Lymphoidcells) <- factor(Lymphoidcells$LymphoidSubset, levels = rev(subset_order))
DefaultAssay(Lymphoidcells) <- "RNA"

# Marker order preserved exactly as used in the subclustering script
FinalLymphoidBiomarkers <- c(
  "Cd3e", "Sell", "Ccr7", "Tcf7",
  "Cd8a", "Cd8b1", "Cd4",
  "Ifng", "Tbx21",
  "Foxp3",
  "Il17f", "Il17a", "Rorc",
  "Trdc", "Trgc1",
  "Il7r", "Il1rl1",
  "Ncr1", "Klrb1c", "Klrk1", "Gzmb", "Prf1", "Cd7", "Xcl1",
  "Cd79a", "Cd19", "Ms4a1"
)
FinalLymphoidBiomarkers <- FinalLymphoidBiomarkers[FinalLymphoidBiomarkers %in% rownames(Lymphoidcells)]

Fig8B_DotPlot <- DotPlot(
  Lymphoidcells,
  features = FinalLymphoidBiomarkers,
  cols     = "RdBu",
  col.min  = -1,
  col.max  = 2
) +
  RotatedAxis() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  guides(
    colour = guide_colorbar(title = "AverExp"),
    size   = guide_legend(title  = "PercExp")
  ) 

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure8B_Lymphoid_MarkerDotPlot.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig8B_DotPlot,
  width    = 7, height = 3
)
Fig8B_DotPlot
```

## Figure 8C: UMAP of lymphoid subsets split by timepoint

```{r fig8c-umap-split, fig.width=14, fig.height=4}
Idents(Lymphoidcells) <- factor(Lymphoidcells$LymphoidSubset, levels = subset_order)

Fig8C_UMAPSplit <- DimPlot(
  Lymphoidcells,
  split.by = "orig.ident",
  label    = FALSE,
  pt.size  = 0.3
) +
  scale_color_manual(values = subset_colors) +
  labs(title = NULL) +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 8))

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure8C_Lymphoid_UMAP_SplitByTimepoint.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig8C_UMAPSplit,
  width    = 14, height = 4
)
Fig8C_UMAPSplit
```

## Figure 8D: Frequencies of each lymphoid subset across timepoints

```{r fig8d-frequency, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
freq_df <- table(Lymphoidcells$orig.ident, Lymphoidcells$LymphoidSubset) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::rename(Timepoint = Var1, Subset = Var2) %>%
  group_by(Timepoint) %>%
  mutate(pct = prop.table(Freq)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = timepoint_order),
    Subset    = factor(Subset,    levels = subset_order)
  )

Fig8D_Freq <- ggplot(freq_df, aes(x = Subset, y = pct, fill = Timepoint)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  labs(x = "Lymphoid subset", y = "Frequency", fill = "Timepoint") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9))

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure8D_Lymphoid_Frequency_Timepoint.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig8D_Freq,
  width    = 7, height = 4
)
Fig8D_Freq


# generate the proportion of these cells in the immune cells
FinalLymphoidCellNumbers <-
  Lymphoidcells@meta.data %>% dplyr::select(orig.ident, FinalLymphoidCellAnnot) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame()
factor(FinalLymphoidCellNumbers$orig.ident)
# set up the level of orig.ident
FinalLymphoidCellNumbers$orig.ident <-
  ordered (
    factor(FinalLymphoidCellNumbers$orig.ident),
    levels = c("0DPI", "3DPI", "7DPI", "28DPI")
  )

FinalLymphoidCellProportion <-
  FinalLymphoidCellNumbers %>% mutate(
    Proprotion = case_when (
      orig.ident == "0DPI" ~ Freq / 566,
      orig.ident == "3DPI" ~ Freq / 1618,
      orig.ident == "7DPI" ~ Freq / 2660,
      orig.ident == "28DPI" ~ Freq / 11902,
    )
  )

LymphoidCellProportionFigure <-
  ggplot(data = FinalLymphoidCellProportion,
         aes(x = FinalLymphoidCellAnnot, y = Proprotion, fill = orig.ident)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +  labs(x = "Cell Type", y = "Frequency", fill = "Timepoint") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggsave(
  "Figure8D_Lymphoid_Frequency_Timepoint.pdf",
  plot = LymphoidCellProportionFigure,
  height = 3.5,
  width = 6
)


```
